solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reorder-data-in-log-files/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

937. Reorder Data in Log Files

You are given an array of logs. Each log is a space-delimited string of words, where the first word is the identifier.

There are two types of logs:
1. Letter-logs: All words (except the identifier) consist of lowercase English letters.
2. Digit-logs: All words (except the identifier) consist of digits.

Reorder these logs so that:
1. The letter-logs come before all digit-logs.
2. The letter-logs are sorted lexicographically by their contents. If their contents are the same, then sort them lexicographically by their identifiers.
3. The digit-logs maintain their relative ordering.

Return the final order of the logs.

Example 1:

Input: logs = ["dig1 8 1 5 1","let1 art can","dig2 3 6","let2 own kit dig","let3 art zero"]
Output: ["let1 art can","let3 art zero","let2 own kit dig","dig1 8 1 5 1","dig2 3 6"]
Explanation:
The letter-log contents are all different, so their ordering is "art can", "art zero", "own kit dig".
The digit-logs have a relative order of "dig1 8 1 5 1", "dig2 3 6".

Example 2:

Input: logs = ["a1 9 2 3 1","g1 act car","zo4 4 7","ab1 off key dog","a8 act zoo"]
Output: ["g1 act car","a8 act zoo","ab1 off key dog","a1 9 2 3 1","zo4 4 7"]

Constraints:

    1 <= logs.length <= 100
    3 <= logs[i].length <= 100
    All the tokens of logs[i] are separated by a single space.
    logs[i] is guaranteed to have an identifier and at least one word after the identifier.
"""


class Solution:
    def reorderLogFiles(self, logs: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        letter_logs = []
        digit_logs = []

        for log in logs:
            id_, rest = log.split(" ", 1)
            if rest[0].isdigit():
                digit_logs.append(log)
            else:
                letter_logs.append((rest, id_))

        # Sort letter logs by content, then by identifier
        letter_logs.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))

        # Reconstruct the logs
        result = [f"{id_} {rest}" for rest, id_ in letter_logs]
        result.extend(digit_logs)
        return result


sol = Solution()

print(
    sol.reorderLogFiles(
        [
            "dig1 8 1 5 1",
            "let1 art can",
            "dig2 3 6",
            "let2 own kit dig",
            "let3 art zero",
        ]
    )
)  # ["let1 art can","let3 art zero","let2 own kit dig","dig1 8 1 5 1","dig2 3 6"]

assert sol.reorderLogFiles(
    ["dig1 8 1 5 1", "let1 art can", "dig2 3 6", "let2 own kit dig", "let3 art zero"]
) == ["let1 art can", "let3 art zero", "let2 own kit dig", "dig1 8 1 5 1", "dig2 3 6"]
assert sol.reorderLogFiles(
    ["a1 9 2 3 1", "g1 act car", "zo4 4 7", "ab1 off key dog", "a8 act zoo"]
) == ["g1 act car", "a8 act zoo", "ab1 off key dog", "a1 9 2 3 1", "zo4 4 7"]
